import sys
import dd4hep
import dd4hep.simulation as sim
import dd4hep.simulation.geant4 as g4

def show_help():
    print("""
DD4hep Simulation Help
----------------------
Usage: python simulation.py [options]

Options:
  -h, --help            Show this help message and exit
  -g, --geometry FILE   Specify geometry file to load
  -n, --nevents N       Number of events to simulate
  -v, --visualize       Enable visualization
  --output FILE         Output file name
  --random-seed SEED    Set random seed
  --field FILE          Magnetic field configuration file
  --physics-list NAME   Physics list to use
  --range-cut VALUE     Global range cut value (mm)
""")

def main():
    import argparse

    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument('-h', '--help', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('-g', '--geometry', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('-n', '--nevents', type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument('-v', '--visualize', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, default='output.root')
    parser.add_argument('--random-seed', type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument('--field', type=str, default=None)
    parser.add_argument('--physics-list', type=str, default='FTFP_BERT')
    parser.add_argument('--range-cut', type=float, default=0.1)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.help:
        show_help()
        sys.exit(0)

    # Setup logger
    logger = sim.Logger()
    logger.setPrintLevel(sim.Logger.INFO)

    # Parse command line arguments
    cmd = sim.CommandLine()
    cmd.parseOptions(sys.argv)

    # Load geometry
    geometry = dd4hep.Geometry(args.geometry)
    sim.import_geometry(geometry)

    # Setup Geant4 kernel
    kernel = sim.DD4hepSimulation()
    sim._configureDD4HEP(kernel)
    kernel.geometry = geometry

    # Setup magnetic field
    if args.field:
        field = sim.MagneticField(args.field)
        sim.setupTrackingField(kernel, field)
    else:
        sim.setupTrackingField(kernel, None)

    # Setup random generator
    if args.random_seed is not None:
        sim.Random.setSeed(args.random_seed)

    # Setup detectors
    sim.setupDetectors(kernel)

    # Setup physics list
    physics = sim.PhysicsList(args.physics_list)
    sim.setupPhysics(kernel, physics)

    # Add special particle types and global range cut
    sim.addPhysics(kernel, "SpecialParticles")
    sim.rangecut(kernel, args.range_cut)

    # Setup simulation particles
    sim.setupUserParticleHandler(kernel)

    # Setup event actions
    event_action = sim.EventAction()
    sim._adopt_event_action(kernel, event_action)

    # Setup I/O
    sim.setupROOTOutput(kernel, args.output)

    # Setup generator actions
    generator_action = sim.GeneratorAction()
    sim.mapActions(kernel, generator_action)

    # Setup user interface
    ui = sim.setupUI(kernel)

    # Enable detailed hits and particle info
    sim.enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo(kernel)

    # Visualization
    if args.visualize:
        sim.commandsPreRun(kernel, [
            "/vis/open OGL",
            "/vis/drawVolume",
            "/vis/viewer/set/viewpointThetaPhi 90 0",
            "/vis/scene/add/trajectories smooth",
            "/vis/scene/endOfEventAction accumulate"
        ])

    # Configure, initialize, run, and terminate kernel
    sim.commandsConfigure(kernel)
    sim.initialize(kernel)
    sim.run(kernel, args.nevents)
    sim.commandsTerminate(kernel)
    sim._kernel_terminate(kernel)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
